Name: Mod stardew valley Expanded Remakened
Author: Stardew valley Pixel art
TagLine: Stardew valley expanded stardew valley expanded Remakened map stardew valley
Description:
Stardew valley Expanded Remakened 
Here are the features:
- Make the world come alive, like adding a little animation to each location!!
- Added new locations!!
- Now each new location is your second, third or fourth agricultural location, or what is called reserve land to continue your business as a farmer.
- Now you can place Casks and make wine using Casks outdoors, such as on farms outside the farm.
- At each new location, you can plant crops. 
- Now you can plant any type of plant in every spring, summer, fall, without worrying about the plant dying.
- In each location there are also full secrets for you to explore!!
- Not only the map or locations are expanded, but the farmhouse is also expanded!!
- Now in every location, you don't have to worry about fainting on the street, now when the player faints, you will arrive home.
